command: fabio reflex query-activations --workspace $WS --id $REFLEX_ID --kql 'ruleactivations_<RULE_ID> | where ___time > ago(24h) | take 10'
description: Execute KQL against Reflex activation records and return typed positional tables.
notes: Rows are positional arrays aligned with columns. Standard KQL data queries, explicit-table union, .show tables, and .show table <name> cslschema are supported. Wildcard union * is rejected. Queries are limited to 1,048,576 characters and may time out after about 30 seconds.
